d.ko: Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game and join Hanna’s adventure in the vibrant city of Eriksholm. The mysterious disappearance of her brother, Herman, ignites a chain of catastrophic events that will forever change their lives and the fate of the entire city.
d.en: Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game and join Hanna’s adventure in the vibrant city of Eriksholm. The mysterious disappearance of her brother, Herman, ignites a chain of catastrophic events that will forever change their lives and the fate of the entire city.
d.zh: 在这款通过叙事推动的等距视角隐蔽类游戏中进入生气蓬勃的城市埃里克斯霍姆，与汉娜一起踏上冒险之旅。汉娜的弟弟赫尔曼神秘失踪，由此引发一连串灾难性事件，彻底改变了大家的生活和整个城市的命运。
